findings.issue: The call through the internal function pointer stored in _coordinatorStages (a JUMP to a value loaded from storage) aborts the function, so the text loses the whole stage: _firstStage (_setupNewGaugeAdder's grantRole/addGaugeType x7/setGaugeFactory x6/renounceRole calls and _deprecateOldGaugeAdder's revokeRole), then _advanceCurrentStage (push of block.timestamp, isComplete, _afterLastStage's renounceRole of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and the nonReentrant exit.
findings.rule: When a jump target is a value read from storage and every store to that storage location in the contract writes a constant JUMPDEST (here only 1790, written by registerStages and performNextStage), decompile the jump as a dispatch over that finite set (one target: a direct call of the internal function at 1790).
findings.verified: pancxx disasm: 0x360 is the jump to the loaded pointer; 0x6fe (1790) is a JUMPDEST that calls 0x863 (_setupNewGaugeAdder) then 0x1679 (_deprecateOldGaugeAdder)
